facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/shadow:.bss
facts.value: During HSD object-system startup, HSD_ShadowInitAllocData passes this descriptor, sizeof(HSD_Shadow), and alignment 4 to HSD_ObjAllocInit. Initialization clears and registers the descriptor and derives its aligned entry size. HSD_ShadowAlloc subsequently consumes it to obtain shadow records, HSD_ShadowRemove returns records through it, and HSD_ObjDumpStat reads its used, free, and peak counters under the label "shadow".
facts.reason: Source declarations/literal uses reviewed, but compiled section identity, size, padding and attribution remain unverified.

unverified_prior_evidence.why: Shows HSD_ObjInit invoking HSD_ShadowInitAllocData and HSD_ObjDumpStat retrieving the descriptor under the label "shadow" to report used, free, and peak values.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/shadow:.bss
facts.value: Its meaningful payload is one HSD_ObjAllocData object. The descriptor itself is 0x2C bytes and contains allocation-limit flags, a free-list head, used/free/peak counters, numeric and heap limits, aligned object size, alignment mask, and a link to the next registered allocator descriptor; the 0x30-byte section contribution leaves four bytes of trailing section padding.
facts.reason: Source declarations/literal uses reviewed, but compiled section identity, size, padding and attribution remain unverified.

unverified_prior_evidence.why: Defines every listed HSD_ObjAllocData field and asserts that the structure occupies 0x2C bytes.
Contains map output showing shadow_alloc_data at 0x804C25D8 in a 0x30-byte shadow.s.o contribution, with the next contribution beginning at 0x804C2608.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/shadow:.bss
facts.value: The descriptor begins as zero-initialized BSS storage. Initialization removes any prior registry references to it, clears it, installs unlimited default numeric and heap-derived limits, sets an alignment mask of 3 and a four-byte-aligned HSD_Shadow stride, and registers it at the head of the allocator list. Each successful allocation removes an entry from its free list, increments used, decrements free, and raises peak when necessary; freeing prepends the record to the free list and performs the inverse used/free transition.
facts.reason: Source declarations/literal uses reviewed, but compiled section identity, size, padding and attribution remain unverified.

unverified_prior_evidence.why: Shows successful allocation removing the free-list head and updating used, free, and peak, and freeing prepending an entry while reversing used/free counts.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/shadow:HSD_ShadowInitAllocData
facts.value: The routine has no caller-supplied inputs or return value. It obtains the address of the persistent shadow_alloc_data descriptor through HSD_ShadowGetAllocData and forwards it with sizeof(HSD_Shadow) and alignment 4 to HSD_ObjAllocInit. That call clears the descriptor, installs default unlimited allocation limits, records an alignment mask of 3, rounds the entry stride to four-byte alignment, and prepends the descriptor to the global allocator registry. HSD_ShadowAlloc, HSD_ShadowRemove, and allocator-statistics reporting later consume the initialized descriptor.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/shadow:HSD_ViewingRectCheck
facts.value: Determines whether an accumulated HSD_ViewingRect contains a nonempty two-dimensional extent suitable for configuring a shadow camera.
facts.reason: TU recheck: ordering-only validation accepts infinite extrema; suitability for camera setup needs finite valid projection preconditions.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/shadow:drawBackgroundRect
facts.value: Reads the shadow camera's top, bottom, left, right, and near projection bounds; multiplies each lateral bound by approximately 1.2 and near by approximately -1.1; and serializes twelve floating-point coordinates as four direct XYZ vertices forming the rectangle (left, top, near), (right, top, near), (right, bottom, near), and (left, bottom, near).
facts.reason: Six GXPosition2f32 calls and their argument ordering reviewed, but the helper definition was not located to independently establish FIFO serialization into four XYZ vertices.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/shadow:drawBackgroundRect
facts.value: Draws the light background of the offscreen shadow image before any shadow-casting objects are rendered. It covers an area slightly larger than the shadow camera's viewing bounds at a depth just beyond the camera near plane, ensuring the render target has a non-shadow background around the caster silhouettes.
facts.reason: TU recheck: unconditional full-background coverage guarantee exceeds local geometry emission; projection validity, raster state and actual stream interpretation are additional preconditions.

facts.subject: main/sysdolphin/baselib/shadow:makeMatrix
facts.value: The camera projection selector chooses one union arm of camera projection parameters. Those parameters, together with shadow->scaleS, scaleT, transS, and transT, produce a temporary light projection matrix; MTXConcat then multiplies that matrix by the camera viewing matrix and writes the product to shadow->texture->mtx for later shadow-texture coordinate generation.
facts.reason: Local body reviewed; exact complete fact also depends on archival or foreign evidence not covered by this packet.

unverified_prior_evidence.why: Corroborates the camera subsystem's perspective, frustum, and orthographic projection-selector convention.
